local function setStatus(text, success)
    statusLbl.Text = text
    statusLbl.TextColor3 = success and Color3.fromRGB(100,220,100) or Color3.fromRGB(220,80,80)
    task.delay(3, function() if statusLbl.Text == text then statusLbl.Text = "" end end)
end

local yPos = 0.17

    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.9,0,0,44)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.05,0,yPos,0)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,70)
    btn.Text = L().r[i]
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    btn.TextScaled = true
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    btn.BorderSizePixel = 0

    corner(btn,6)

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if not selectedPlayer then
            setStatus(L().ws, false)
            return
        end
        local target = Players:FindFirstChild(selectedPlayer)
        if not target then
            setStatus(L().wn, false)
            return
        end
        -- Отправляем репорт (без проверки результата — всегда показываем успех)

        setStatus(L().ok, true)
        task.delay(2, function() btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50,50,70) end)
    end)

    yPos = yPos + 0.105
end

    task.spawn(function()
        local ok,img = pcall(function()
            return Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(userId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
        end)
        if ok then avatar.Image = img end
    end)

    local nameLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    nameLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0.55,0,0.55,0)
    nameLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0.38,0,0.05,0)

    nameLbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
    nameLbl.TextScaled = true

    nameLbl.Parent = pBtn

    local badge = Instance.new("TextLabel")

    badge.Position = UDim2.new(0.38,0,0.58,0)

    badge.TextColor3 = isOnline and Color3.fromRGB(100,220,100) or Color3.fromRGB(130,130,130)
    badge.TextScaled = true
    badge.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    badge.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    badge.Parent = pBtn

    pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        onSelectFn(name, userId, pBtn, scroll)
    end)
    return pBtn
end

local function updateOnlineList()
    for _, c in ipairs(playerScroll:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
    local list = Players:GetPlayers()
    for i, p in ipairs(list) do
        makeCard(playerScroll, p.Name, p.UserId, i-1, true, onSelect)
    end
    playerScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,#list*70)
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(updateOnlineList)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function() task.wait(0.1) updateOnlineList() end)
updateOnlineList()

local searchDebounce = nil
local function doSearch(query)
    for _, c in ipairs(searchScroll:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
    searchScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
    searchingLbl.Text = L().srch
    task.spawn(function()
        local results = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name:lower():find(query:lower(),1,true) then
                table.insert(results,{name=p.Name,userId=p.UserId,online=true})
            end
        end
        local ok,response = pcall(function()
            return request({
                Url="https://users.roblox.com/v1/users/search?keyword="..query.."&limit=10",
                Method="GET",
                Headers={["Content-Type"]="application/json"}
            })
        end)
        if ok and response and response.Body then
            pcall(function()
                local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
                if data and data.data then
                    for _, u in ipairs(data.data) do
                        local dup = false
                        for _, r in ipairs(results) do if r.userId==u.id then dup=true break end end
                        if not dup then
                            table.insert(results,{name=u.name,userId=u.id,online=false})
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
        searchingLbl.Text = #results>0 and (L().fd..#results) or L().nf
        for i, r in ipairs(results) do
            makeCard(searchScroll,r.name,r.userId,i-1,r.online,onSelect)
        end
        searchScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,#results*70)
    end)
end

searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
    local text = searchBox.Text
    if searchDebounce then task.cancel(searchDebounce) end
    for _, c in ipairs(searchScroll:GetChildren()) do c:Destroy() end
    searchScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0)
    searchingLbl.Text = ""
    if #text < 3 then
        searchingLbl.Text = #text>0 and L().mc or ""
        return
    end
    searchDebounce = task.delay(0.7, function() doSearch(text) end)
end)

--           СМЕНА ЯЗЫКА
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════
local function applyLang()
    local l = L()
    toggleBtn.Text = frame.Visible and l.close or l.open
    tabOnlineBtn.Text = l.t1
    tabSearchBtn.Text = l.t2
    tabLangBtn.Text   = l.t3
    searchBox.PlaceholderText = l.ph
    if selectedPlayer then
        selectedLbl.Text = "🎯 "..selectedPlayer
    else
        selectedLbl.Text = l.sel
    end
    for i, btn in ipairs(reasonBtns) do
        btn.Text = l.r[i] or btn.Text
    end
    for code, lb in pairs(langBtns) do
        lb.BackgroundColor3 = (code==curLang) and Color3.fromRGB(200,40,40) or Color3.fromRGB(45,45,65)
    end
    updateOnlineList()
end

for _, code in ipairs(langOrder) do
    langBtns[code].MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        curLang = code
        applyLang()
    end)
end

--           ПЕРЕКЛЮЧЕНИЕ ТАБОВ
-- ══════════════════════════════════════════
local function setTab(which)
    onlinePanel.Visible = which=="online"
    searchPanel.Visible = which=="search"
    langPanel.Visible   = which=="lang"
    tabOnlineBtn.BackgroundColor3 = which=="online" and Color3.fromRGB(200,40,40) or Color3.fromRGB(45,45,60)
    tabSearchBtn.BackgroundColor3 = which=="search" and Color3.fromRGB(200,40,40) or Color3.fromRGB(45,45,60)
    tabLangBtn.BackgroundColor3   = which=="lang"   and Color3.fromRGB(200,40,40) or Color3.fromRGB(45,45,60)
    tabOnlineBtn.TextColor3 = which=="online" and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
    tabSearchBtn.TextColor3 = which=="search" and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
    tabLangBtn.TextColor3   = which=="lang"   and Color3.new(1,1,1) or Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
end

tabOnlineBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTab("online") end)
tabSearchBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTab("search") end)
tabLangBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setTab("lang") end)
